segments.title: Millions of butterflies fly to Mexico!
segments.say: Every winter, monarch butterflies fly all the way to Mexico. Diego from Mexico City loves them!

segments.title: What colour are monarch wings?
segments.say: What colour are monarch butterflies? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Orange and black!
segments.source: Minnesota DNR: orange wings, black veins
segments.say: Orange and black, with little white spots!

segments.title: They winter in Mexico
segments.say: They spend the winter in forests west of Mexico City.
